adGuide.step1Body: Select whether you want to buy or sell. Buyers browse existing ads; sellers create ads for others to respond to.
adGuide.step2BodyBuy: Select the currency you'll pay with.
adGuide.step2BodySell: Select the currency you'll receive in.
adGuide.step3Body: Enter a fixed rate or a floating rate as a percentage of the live market price. Floating rates keep your ad competitive automatically.
adGuide.step4BodyBuy: Add the total amount you're buying. Then set the minimum and maximum amount sellers can order.
adGuide.step4BodySell: Add the total amount you're selling. Then set the minimum and maximum amount buyers can order.
adGuide.step5BodyBuy: Choose how you'll pay and add any instructions.
adGuide.step5BodySell: Choose how you'll get paid and add any instructions.
adGuide.step6BodyBuy: Set the payment time limit and who can respond to this ad. Then, tap **Create ad**.
adGuide.step6BodySell: Set the payment time limit and who can respond to this ad. Then, tap **Create ad**.

guide.step1Body: USD худалдан авах болон зарах хооронд шилж. Боломжтой зарлагчдыг үзэхийн тулд **Худалдан авах** дээр дар, эсвэл зах дээр боломжтой худалдан авагчдыг үзэхийн тулд **Зарах** дээр дар.

guide.step5BodyBuy: Энэ зарлагчтай захиалга эхлүүлэхийн тулд **Buy USD** дээр дар. Баталгаажуулахаасаа өмнө тэдний төлбөрийн нөхцлийг хянах болно.
guide.step5BodySell: Энэ зарлагчтай захиалга эхлүүлэхийн тулд **Sell USD** дээр дар. Баталгаажуулахаасаа өмнө тэдний төлбөрийн нөхцлийг хянах болно.

learnPage.title: Learn P2P Trading
learnPage.whatIsP2pBody: P2P (peer-to-peer) trading lets you buy and sell cryptocurrency directly with other people — without a bank or broker in the middle.
learnPage.step1Body: Pick the best rates and place an order, or create an ad for the rates you want.
learnPage.step2Body: Settle the payment with the counterparty of your transaction.
learnPage.step3Body: Every order must be completed and confirmed within the specified time limit.
learnPage.termAdvertiserRatingBody: A score based on past trade reviews. Higher-rated advertisers are more reliable.
learnPage.termExchangeRateBody: The price at which one currency is exchanged for another. Can be fixed or floating.
learnPage.termEscrowBody: Funds held securely during a trade, released only when both parties confirm.
